chapter.title: Chapter Nine: The Morning After
chapter.subtitle: The crown schedules games. It does not own the roof.
chapter.description: A victory cleanup becomes an emergency when Techbro Rich arrives to sell the rooftop back to its own neighborhood.

tips: Listen for the terms before the first contest.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: I found three trophies, one left shoe, and a crockpot still set to WARM. The Crown has consequences.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Blue
scenes.text: Put my folding throne by the stairs. I am retiring it with dignity.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: It is six chairs zip-tied together. Carry your dignity one chair at a time.

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: I got here early. The little one's place is set before anybody asks.

scenes.speaker: Baby Momma
scenes.text: Good. Saturday at ten, library steps. Bring snacks you can identify without a logo.

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: Ten sharp. Apples, crackers, and no entrance music.

scenes.speaker: OG Uncle
scenes.text: Look at that. Ten o’clock. I’m setting an alarm for you and a second one for your excuses.

scenes.speaker: Snitch
scenes.text: Hold the tenderness. A man in white sneakers is measuring the roof with his phone.

scenes.speaker: Techbro Rich
scenes.text: Great energy up here. Authentic wear patterns. You cannot manufacture this distress.

scenes.speaker: Alley Runner
scenes.text: You are standing in spilled peach soda.

scenes.speaker: Techbro Rich
scenes.text: Exactly. Organic patina.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Red
scenes.text: State your business before Cornball catalogs you as abandoned property.

scenes.speaker: Techbro Rich
scenes.text: The sale closes soon. I am converting this into RichRoof, a members-only culture platform.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: We already have a culture platform. It is that milk crate. Sometimes it wobbles.

scenes.speaker: Techbro Rich
scenes.text: Founding memberships start at ninety-nine dollars. Neighbors get a commemorative discount.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: A discount to enter the place we cleaned for free? Blue, unfold one chair. I need to sit before I cuss professionally.

scenes.speaker: Baby Momma
scenes.text: Who signed, what exactly transfers, and when do you think we leave? Three questions. No pitch deck.

scenes.speaker: Techbro Rich
scenes.text: The owner's broker signed the term sheet. Final access begins after inspection.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Blue
scenes.text: The Crown schedule says open play next Friday.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Red
scenes.text: A schedule is not a deed. We protect Friday while we learn what was actually promised.

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: Then make him put tonight’s setup on the table. We need time to check his paperwork.

scenes.speaker: Techbro Rich
scenes.text: Fine. Three promotional tables. Win, and my launch crew leaves tonight's setup untouched.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: Say that on Snitch's camera, including the word tonight.

scenes.speaker: Snitch
scenes.text: Already wide, already live, and for once nobody paid me to crop it.

tips: Its result settles only the stated event term.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Velvet rope caught his own backpack. Premium gravity confirmed.

postDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
postDialogue.text: Good. Photograph every label before anything move.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
postDialogue.text: Labels first. Stories later. Order of operations.

postDialogue.speaker: Wifey

tips: Order the evidence by its authentic timestamps.

puzzle.title: The launch was already loaded
puzzle.instruction: Order the five records by real time. All are Wednesday except the owner’s Monday notice. Dispatch runs 20 minutes fast; other clocks are correct. What was already underway when Rich made his promise?

pieces.label: Launch crate enters — Wednesday 20:03
pieces.detail: Correct gate clock. Seal matches the truck manifest.

pieces.label: Owner’s notice — Monday 10:00
pieces.detail: Correct office clock. Inspection window announced.

pieces.label: Order generated — Wednesday 19:50
pieces.detail: Fast dispatch clock. Equipment marked RELEASE IMMEDIATELY.

pieces.label: Truck departs — Wednesday 20:12
pieces.detail: Fast dispatch clock. Loaded with the launch crates.

hints: Subtract twenty minutes from both dispatch entries.
The truck left at 19:52, before the 20:00 promise.
puzzle.solvedText: Order at 19:30, truck away at 19:52, promise at 20:00, crates through the gate at 20:03. The loading plan was already in motion; the matching seal connects it to Rich’s equipment.
puzzle.skipText: The group orders the copies together. You receive the same story progress, with no puzzle bonus.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Red
scenes.text: Five records. Correct dispatch’s clock before we accuse him.

scenes.speaker: Snitch
scenes.text: My stream clock is synced. Dispatch has been twenty minutes fast all month.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: I knew those drivers were living in the future.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: Read the times, Doctor Strange.

tips: Its result settles only the stated event term.

preDialogue.speaker: Live Streamer
preDialogue.text: Rich promised my channel exclusive rooftop access and a fog machine.

preDialogue.speaker: Snitch
preDialogue.text: Exclusive is hard with forty-seven people behind you.

preDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
preDialogue.text: Win the announced scrimmage; their sponsor crates leave the family corner.

preDialogue.speaker: Live Streamer
preDialogue.text: Fine, but the fog machine is emotionally essential.

preDialogue.speaker: Snitch
preDialogue.text: Exclusive hard when forty-seven people behind you. Optics is a myth.

preDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma

preDialogue.speaker: Live Streamer
preDialogue.text: Fine, but the fog machine is emotionally essential.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: Emotionally essential fog. File that under “things we never needed.”

preDialogue.speaker: Snitch
preDialogue.text: I’m live either way. Fog or no fog, the ratio don’t care about your feelings.

postDialogue.speaker: Live Streamer
postDialogue.text: Crates are moving. Fog machine stays off until it stops coughing.

postDialogue.speaker: Snitch
postDialogue.text: It coughed glitter into Rich's sparkling water.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
postDialogue.text: Family corner is clear. Keep it clear.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue

postDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
postDialogue.text: Clear is the only setting that work around here.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Glitter water is now evidence. Don’t drink the exhibit.

passive.name: Announced Terms
passive.description: The final table escalates once without changing the agreement outside the match.

preDialogue.speaker: Delivery Demon
preDialogue.text: I have six work orders and three different addresses for this same roof.

preDialogue.speaker: Alley Runner
preDialogue.text: Then our contest decides whose inventory gets staged by the stairs, not who owns anything.

preDialogue.speaker: Delivery Demon
preDialogue.text: Winner picks the safe loading lane. Loser carries the inflatable R.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: Why is there an inflatable R?

preDialogue.speaker: Delivery Demon
preDialogue.text: RichRoof branding. The second R escaped on the expressway.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball

preDialogue.speaker: Delivery Demon
preDialogue.text: RichRoof branding. Second R escaped on the expressway.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: So we missing a letter and a plan. Classic.

preDialogue.speaker: Alley Runner
preDialogue.text: Safe lane first. Missing letters later.

postDialogue.speaker: Delivery Demon
postDialogue.text: Safe lane is yours. I am logging the conflicting orders instead of dumping boxes.

postDialogue.speaker: Alley Runner
postDialogue.text: Give me copies. Routes tell the truth people forget to mention.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: The inflatable R is now wearing Blue's crown. Nobody touch it.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Inflatable R now wearing Blue crown. Nobody touch it. It’s art.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
postDialogue.text: That crown was retired with dignity.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Dignity temporary. Inflatable R permanent. Deal with it.

tips: The match result and the real-world agreement remain separate.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Red
scenes.text: This does not cancel a sale. It documents a contradiction and buys us a clean inspection.

scenes.speaker: Baby Momma
scenes.text: Copies go to the owner, every tenant contact, and nobody's private family thread.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Blue
scenes.text: I wanted the Crown to fix this because wearing it was easier than asking for help.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: Growth is noticing that before you build another chair throne.

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: Night watch is covered. I leave at nine-fifteen for Saturday's snacks.

scenes.speaker: OG Uncle
scenes.text: And I am alive, awake, and taking the midnight shift with a thermos.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: I assigned the inflatable R second watch. It has no eyelids, which is ideal.

scenes.speaker: Snitch
scenes.text: Rich is gone for tonight. His paperwork is not.

scenes.speaker: Alley Runner
scenes.text: Then tomorrow we raise money, fix what is ours to fix, and make leaving us harder than listening.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: Everybody pick up something heavy. Including Blue’s expectations.
